[P2] Propagate the fields to every job logger

This dictionary enriches only `_JobRunner`'s direct log calls. `_run_job_and_report` still passes the shared `self._logger` to `Heartbeats`, `CallbackReporter`, and `AgentcoreJobContext`. Consequently, heartbeat failures, callback warnings, and handler logs lack `jobCount`, violating the new logging contract and disappearing from queries filtered by that field. Pass a logger carrying the job's fields to these consumers while preserving their existing `extra` fields, and add assertions covering those logs; the added test checks only `job started`.
